author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Label open Decisions, review findings and pull requests
purpose: Adds local, advisory labels to open Decisions, review findings and pull requests, so the operator can see which ones agents can handle and which need a person. The labels never answer, approve or resolve anything.
serves: The Project outcome of asking the operator for a decision only when one is genuinely needed.
done_when: Each open Decision and review finding shows a label and a short reason, and each pull request shows whether it can merge on green or needs the operator.

actions.title: Label each open Decision as agent-answerable or operator-only
actions.why: Lets the operator skip Decisions an agent can handle, without any answer being given automatically.
actions.done_when: Each open Decision shows one label, a recommended option and a one-line reason, produced locally and never answering the Decision.

actions.title: Label each review finding as valid, declined or needing a person
actions.why: Sorts automated review comments so the operator looks only at those that need judgement.
actions.done_when: Each review finding gets one label and a reason, and the label never resolves a thread or changes code by itself.

actions.title: Decide whether a pull request can merge on green
actions.why: Makes the merge rule explicit, so pull requests that need the operator are flagged rather than merged silently.
actions.done_when: Given a pull request's facts, the rule returns merge-on-green or operator-required with a reason, and each exclusion has a test.

actions.title: Suggest a model tier for each Action
actions.why: Gives a starting tier from the Action's scope, without overriding a tier the plan sets.
actions.done_when: Each Action gets a light, standard or heavy tier suggestion with a reason, and an explicit pin is never overridden.
